LightningComponentBundle.description: Landing page for the Landers x Pag-IBIG one-day pass partnership.

property.name: membershipId
property.label: Day pass membership ID
property.description: Shared Landers membership number encoded in the printed barcode.

property.name: membershipName
property.label: Day pass membership name
property.default: PAG IBIG LANDERS ALL STORE DAYPASS

property.name: autoResetSeconds
property.label: Auto-reset after (seconds)
property.description: Seconds on the pass screen before the kiosk returns to the scan step. 0 disables.

property.name: registerUrl
property.label: Register Now URL (unused)
property.description: No longer used - the CTAs open the registration modal. Retained because Experience Builder will not allow removing a property that a placed component still references.
